title: 025 技能点026 跟你爹约会
slug: 从小欢喜开启诸天之旅
content_zh:
冲刺班的学习情况跟之前在三班时候比起又上升了一个台阶，各科的难度都有所提升。
春风中学给这一届高三冲刺班的目标是冲刺清北。
乔英子也感受到了冲刺班里的那种学习氛围，连着跟陆泽说话的时间都少了不少，而陆泽凭借着高达十四点的精神属性，在学习上面并没有感到更多的压力。
我陆某人真没开挂！
再度唤醒系统，个人面板快速出现。
【宿主：陆泽】
【当前所处世界：小欢喜】
【身份：春风中学高三学生】
【精神：14】
【体质：8】
【力量：5】
【敏捷：5】
【技能：驾驶入门LV1（本本族）；厨艺入门LV1（西红柿炒蛋专业户）；高中物理精通LV2（物理小王子）】
【系统可分配点数：0】
【目前未完成任务：同病相怜（帮助林磊儿解开母亲去世心结）】
陆泽在这个下午一边学习，一边思考着如何帮助林磊儿解开心结。
母亲的忽然去世导致这個男生在亲情那一块的联接忽然破裂开来，陆泽隐约记得林磊儿的爸爸好像在他母亲去世没多久就找了个新的，而继母对磊儿自然好不到哪里去。
这也是为什么童文洁会决定把磊儿接到这里上学。
说起来，陆泽跟林磊儿的身世真的极其相似，只不过陆泽的遭遇听上去要更惨一点，父母双亡。
解铃还须系铃人。

原生家庭的问题最终还是要在原生家庭身上解决。
跟英子家里的情况不一样，按道理来说只要林磊儿在方家住上一段时间，这一大家子的温情关系很容易就会感染到这个眼镜男孩，他的心结自然也就解开了。
可这种解决方式似乎跟陆泽没什么关系。
“果然啊。”
“世上根本没有白吃的午餐。”
陆泽暂时没有想到好的解决方法，他也就不再去纠结。
......
“英子，你在偷吃什么呢？”
“你竟然背着我吃独食，赶快给我来点。”
......
随着下午放学铃声响起，许多人习惯性的收拾好书包准备撤退，但是忽然间想起来还有晚自习。
只见这群高三学生们纷纷摇头叹气，接着又坐了回去，透过二楼的玻璃窗看着高一、高二的学弟学妹们开开心心的走向校门方向，他们开始有些怀念当初的自己。
陆泽对于晚自习倒是习以为常。
春风中学规定夏季的晚自习时间是18：20——19：45，一共一个小时二十五分钟的时间，中间会有一个十五分钟的课间休息时间。
每个班里每天都会有负责当值的老师，晚自习用以答疑解惑。
今天冲刺班的晚自习是数学，班主任李萌拿着这次分班考试的试卷来到了班里。
“这个晚自习前半段我们来讲这次考试的卷子，后半段你们自由复习。”
“大家听清楚了没有？”
台下响起学生们统一拉长的声调：“听~清~楚~了~”
李萌刚准备开始讲题，往陆泽那边看了一眼：“对了，我们冲刺班现在需要个数学课代表来帮我，我决定选一名男生当课代表，陆泽，别看了，就你了。”

准备看戏的陆泽有些傻眼，伸手指着自己：“啊？李萌老师，我吗？”
content_en:
The learning situation in the sprint class has gone up a notch compared to the previous time in class three, and the difficulty of each subject has increased.
The goal given by Chunfeng Middle School to this senior sprint class is to sprint to Qingbei.
Qiao Yingzi also felt the learning atmosphere in the sprint class, and spent a lot less time talking to Lu Ze. Lu Ze, with his fourteen-point mental attribute, did not feel any more pressure in his studies.
I, Lu, am really not cheating!
Wake up the system again, and the personal panel will appear quickly.
[Host: Lu Ze]
[Current World: Little Joy]
[Identity: Senior high school student at Chunfeng Middle School]
【Spirit: 14】
[Physique: 8]
【Strength: 5】
[Agility: 5]
[Skills: LV1 for beginners in driving (Benbenzu); LV1 for beginners in cooking (specialized in tomato scrambled eggs); LV2 for high school physics proficiency (Little Prince of Physics)]
[The system can allocate points: 0]
[Currently unfinished task: Compassion in the same disease (helping Lin Leier untie the knot of her mother’s death)]
Lu Ze was studying this afternoon while thinking about how to help Lin Lei'er untie her knot.
The sudden death of his mother caused the boy's family connection to suddenly break. Lu Ze vaguely remembered that Lin Lei'er's father seemed to have found a new one not long after his mother's death, and the stepmother was naturally not much better to Lei'er.
This is why Tong Wenjie decided to take Lei'er to school here.
Speaking of which, the life experiences of Lu Ze and Lin Lei'er are really very similar, except that Lu Ze's experience sounds a bit more miserable, as both his parents died.
To untie the bell, one must tie the bell.
The problems of the original family must ultimately be solved by the original family.
Unlike the situation in Yingzi's family, it stands to reason that as long as Lin Lei'er lives in the Fang family for a period of time, the warm relationship between the family will easily be infected by the boy with glasses, and his knot will naturally be resolved.
But this solution seems to have nothing to do with Lu Ze.
"As expected."
“There is no such thing as a free lunch.”
Lu Ze didn't think of a good solution for the time being, so he stopped worrying about it.
...
"Yingzi, what are you eating secretly?"
"You're actually eating alone behind my back. Give me some quickly."
...
As the school bell rang in the afternoon, many people habitually packed their schoolbags and prepared to retreat, but suddenly they remembered that there was still evening self-study.
I saw this group of high school seniors shaking their heads and sighing, and then sat back. Through the glass windows on the second floor, they watched the first and second grade students happily walking towards the school gate. They began to miss themselves a little.
Lu Ze was accustomed to studying late at night.
Chunfeng Middle School stipulates that the evening self-study time in summer is 18:20-19:45, a total of one hour and twenty-five minutes, with a fifteen-minute break in the middle.
There will be a teacher on duty in each class every day, who will answer questions during evening self-study.
Today's evening self-study for the sprint class is mathematics. The head teacher Li Meng came to the class with the papers for the placement test.
"In the first half of this evening self-study, we will talk about the exam papers. In the second half, you can review them freely."
"Did everyone hear that clearly?"
The students' unified and elongated voices sounded from the audience: "Listen~clear~clear~"
Just as Li Meng was about to start lecturing, he glanced at Lu Ze and said, "By the way, our sprint class now needs a math class representative to help me. I decided to choose a boy to be the class representative. Lu Ze, don't look at it, it's you."
Lu Ze, who was about to watch the show, was a little dumbfounded and pointed at himself: "Ah? Teacher Li Meng, me?"
